summary: The source-held current-public local-save Orca extension retains its full controller/typed-plan/template-producer/archive and actual producer-custody requirements. Independent review found that the first candidate authenticated journey.json but accepted independently changed receipt sequences. An assembled valid receipt with event and sample sequences increased by100 and every original file/hash/terminal unchanged reproduced that defect. The current-only binder now requires actions, observations, journey, firstCause, process and browser to equal the completion-bound original journey; only browser.transportOutcome is derived afterward and remains checked against exact original browser records. Legacy external-mode behavior and the embedded JS bytes are unchanged. The existing external-reference source workflow now watches and explicitly runs the focused AT test file once in PR static controls and once in reusable preflight, each bounded by120s wall/CPU with5s kill grace and16MiB file limit. The maintained finite validator checks both registrations; actual-helper mutants remove each route/path or change the bound and refuse. Seventeen focused Python tests and retained observer pure controls with logging disabled passed under1CPU/512MiB sampled aggregate RSS, normal virtual address limits, with original children reaped and private temporary roots removed. The original causal failed check and frozen first candidate are preserved. No Node, GI, SDK, browser, AT, network or native unit was launched. Embedded JS handler controls remain unrun and require a separately selected exact executable/profile. CURRENT_PUBLIC_AT_ADMISSION remains None; ordinary source CI delivery, protected dependency integration, full current-public custody/caller integration, provider/Studio applicability, native IME and actual desktop acceptance remain open. Local-save storage remains synthetic in-memory and no full4817, durable-save or provider-matrix acceptance is claimed.
title: Current AT original journey projections and finite source CI are bound; native journey remains held
